import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 23

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/

namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture23

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 23](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

For a simple connected graph `G`, `b(G) ≥ ⌊α(G) + dist_avg(M, V) / 2⌋`, where `b(G)` is
the size of a largest induced bipartite subgraph, `α(G)` is the independence number,
and `M` is the set of maximum-degree vertices, and `dist_avg(M, V)` is the average
distance from all vertices to `M`.

This conjecture is false; there is a counterexample with `b(G) = 19`, `α(G) = 15`,
and `dist_avg(M, V) = 10`.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture23 : answer(False) ↔
  ∀ (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]
    (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.Connected),
    let M : Set α := {v | G.degree v = G.maxDegree}
    ⌊(G.indepNum : ℝ) + distavg G M / 2⌋ ≤ (b G : ℝ) := by
  sorry

-- Sanity checks

/-- The invariant `b G` is nonneg. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) : 0 ≤ b G := Nat.cast_nonneg _

/-- In `K₃`, the max degree is 2. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)).maxDegree = 2 := by decide +native

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture23

findings.description: The statement uses the wrong distance invariant. `distavg G M` expands to (1/|V|)·∑_{v∈V} min_{m∈M} d(v,m): the average distance to the nearest maximum-degree vertex. The source instead averages d(u,v) over distinct pairs of maximum-degree vertices. These produce inequivalent inequalities: a connected 19-vertex graph verified in `/workspace/review/witness.lean` has independence number 11, bipartite number 15, and two maximum-degree vertices at distance 10, whereas `distavg G M = 39/19`. The source's bound is therefore the false inequality 16 ≤ 15, while Lean's bound is the true inequality 12 ≤ 15. The docstring also incorrectly replaces the source's `dist_avg(M)` with `dist_avg(M,V)` and the nearest-set interpretation.
findings.source_evidence: DeLaVina's WOWII list, http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/all.html, Conjecture 23, states: “If G is a simple connected graph, then b(G) ≥ FLOOR[α(G) + dist_avg(M)/2]” and explicitly links definition 26. Definition 26 in http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/wowIIdefs.js is titled “average distance between maximum degree vertices” and says: “Let M be the set of vertices of maximum degree of the graph. Then dist_avg is the average of all nonzero dist_G(u,v) such that u and v are in M.” Both were checked in July 2026 archived copies.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace `distavg G M` with the pairwise average within M. For example, let `S : Finset α := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = G.maxDegree)` and `P := S.offDiag`, and use `(∑ p ∈ P, (G.dist p.1 p.2 : ℝ)) / (P.card : ℝ)`. Connectedness makes distinct pairs exactly the nonzero-distance pairs. Document the value 0 when there are fewer than two maximum-degree vertices; that case gives the trivial bound `G.indepNum ≤ b G`. Correct the docstring accordingly, retaining `answer(False)` and `research solved`.

sources_consulted: http://web.archive.org/web/20260726061534/http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/all.html — Conjecture 23, its counterexample note, and surrounding remarks
review.notes: The source marks Conjecture 23 F and records the July 2005 counterexample with b=19, α=15 and dist_avg(M)=10, so the status and negative answer are correct. Both sanity checks and the boundary/cast checks passed in `/workspace/review/scratch.lean`. The independent 19-vertex witness consists of four paws: for i=0,…,3, triangle a_i,b_i,c_i plus edge c_i–d_i; connect d_i–a_{i+1} for i<3, add two leaves at a_0 and one at c_3. Its admissibility, invariants, and differing inequalities were proved in `/workspace/review/witness.lean`, using native_decide for finite computations; the proof has no sorry dependency. An independent exhaustive Perl computation also confirmed the invariants. All review files were written under `/workspace/review/`.

submission.summary: Replaced the nearest-set distance average with the real-valued average over distinct pairs of maximum-degree vertices using `M.offDiag`. Corrected the docstring and documented the zero value for an empty average, preserving the negative answer, solved status, and sanity checks. The required compilation succeeds with only the permitted `sorry` warning.

import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 23

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/

namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture23

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 23](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

For a simple connected graph `G`, `b(G) ≥ ⌊α(G) + dist_avg(M) / 2⌋`, where `b(G)` is
the size of a largest induced bipartite subgraph, `α(G)` is the independence number,
and `M` is the set of maximum-degree vertices. Here `dist_avg(M)` is the average
distance between distinct vertices in `M`. It is defined to be `0` when `M` has
fewer than two vertices, in which case the bound reduces to `α(G) ≤ b(G)`.

This conjecture is false; there is a counterexample with `b(G) = 19`, `α(G) = 15`,
and `dist_avg(M) = 10`.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture23 : answer(False) ↔
  ∀ (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]
    (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.Connected),
    let M : Finset α := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = G.maxDegree)
    let pairs := M.offDiag
    let avgDist : ℝ := (∑ p ∈ pairs, (G.dist p.1 p.2 : ℝ)) / (pairs.card : ℝ)
    ⌊(G.indepNum : ℝ) + avgDist / 2⌋ ≤ (b G : ℝ) := by
  sorry

-- Sanity checks

/-- The invariant `b G` is nonneg. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) : 0 ≤ b G := Nat.cast_nonneg _

/-- In `K₃`, the max degree is 2. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)).maxDegree = 2 := by decide +native

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture23
